::: {#exm-list-length}
#### The length of `'(7 2 9)`

In Racket, the definition of length (@def-list-length) is

```racket
(define (len L)
  (if (empty? L)
      0
      (+ 1 (len (rest L)))))
```

where `(empty? L)` tests whether `L` is the empty list.
Replacing each call with the recursive rule:

```text
(len '(7 2 9))
= (+ 1 (len '(2 9)))
= (+ 1 (+ 1 (len '(9))))
= (+ 1 (+ 1 (+ 1 (len '()))))
= (+ 1 (+ 1 (+ 1 0)))
= 3
```

Racket's built-in `length` gives the same values.

:::
